verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions AWS Organizations, organizational units, sandbox accounts, service control policies, or any documented multi-account isolation pattern. What it does show are adjacent controls: IAM policies and permissions boundaries, a Budgets action that denies provisioning within an account, and Resource Groups for tag-based organization. None of these is the multi-account/project isolation capability the story asks for, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As a developer, experiments cannot hurt prod — documented multi-account/project isolation patterns (org units, sandboxes) with guardrails
